add_shaper_pipe.description: Create a traffic shaper pipe (apply=true by default)

aliases.description: List firewall aliases (IP groups, port groups, etc)

search.description: Filter by alias name, type, or content

apply_shaper.description: Apply pending traffic shaper configuration via service/reconfigure

apply_shaper_preset.description: Apply bufferbloat_wan preset: FQ-CoDel pipes at 85% ISP rates, queues, dual-stack WAN rules

apply_ula.description: Load staged VIP, NPT, router advertisement and Unbound changes, in order

dry_run.description: Report what would run without doing it (default true)

audit_shaper_config.description: Audit traffic shaper configuration against best practices; optional ISP rates and WAN line rate for bandwidth checks

isp_download_mbit.description: Reference ISP download rate in Mbit/s

isp_upload_mbit.description: Reference ISP upload rate in Mbit/s

wan_line_rate_mbit.description: WAN physical line rate cap in Mbit/s

delete_shaper_pipe.description: Delete a traffic shaper pipe; requires confirm token from prior call

dhcp.description: Show DHCPv4 and DHCPv6 lease tables

search.description: Filter leases by hostname, IP, or MAC address. Omit for full table.

dhcp_lease_delete.description: Delete DHCP leases by hostname, IP, or MAC address

diff_config_backups.description: Show the differences between two stored configuration revisions

search.description: Filter by hostname, IP, or description

download_config.description: Download the firewall configuration to a file on the MCP host and return its path, size and checksum. The XML is never returned.

revision.description: Revision id to fetch; omit for the running config

explain_shaper_config.description: Explain traffic shaper configuration in plain language for non-technical users

include_audit.description: When true, run audit first and weave findings into the narrative

flush_dns.description: Flush Unbound DNS cache for a hostname (SSH unbound-control) or restart Unbound (API) to clear all cached answers

hostname.description: FQDN to flush from cache (e.g. headroom.frobozz.example). Required when mode=name.

mode.description: name: flush one hostname via unbound-control (default); restart: restart Unbound via API (clears full cache)

fw_ping.description: Ping a target from the firewall itself, which is the path that matters when checking a gateway or transit

packetsize.description: Payload bytes, for checking MTU on a transit

source_address.description: Source address, to test a specific path

fw_rules.description: Get firewall rules exposed by the OPNsense Firewall Automation API (Firewall → Automation). Rules that exist only under the classic Firewall → Rules UI may not appear here; see OPNsense API docs. Returns the current rule set for context and reasoning.

action.description: Filter by action (pass, block, reject, etc.)

interface.description: Filter by interface name (supports partial matching and groups)

protocol.description: Filter by protocol (tcp, udp, icmp, etc.)

gateway_status.description: Show WAN gateway health (latency, packet loss)

get_logs.description: Get firewall logs with optional filtering

get_shaper_pipe.description: Get one traffic shaper pipe by uuid or description substring

description.description: Description substring when uuid is omitted

get_shaper_queue.description: Get one traffic shaper queue by uuid or description substring

description.description: Description substring when uuid is omitted

get_shaper_rule.description: Get one traffic shaper rule by uuid or description substring

description.description: Description substring when uuid is omitted

get_shaper_settings.description: Get global traffic shaper settings and normalized pipe/queue/rule summary

interface_health.description: Summarize interface status, counters, relationships, and findings

interface_list.description: Get available interface names for firewall rules

list_config_backups.description: List stored OPNsense configuration revisions, newest first

list_dhcp_hosts.description: List DHCP host reservations from the dnsmasq host table (Services → DHCPv4 → Hosts). Unlike the dhcp tool (leases), this returns configured static mappings including IPv4, optional ::N IPv6 suffix, MAC, client_id, and descr.

descr.description: Optional client-side filter: reservation descr substring (e.g. VLAN2wired)

missing_ipv6.description: When true, return only reservations with IPv4 but no ::N IPv6 suffix

search.description: Optional filter passed to OPNsense searchPhrase (hostname, MAC, IP fragment, etc.)

list_dhcp_subnet_dns.description: List DHCP-provided DNS servers for a subnet scope (dnsmasq or Kea backends)

interface.description: Interface identifier or description (e.g. opt2, VLAN2wired)

list_gateways.description: List configured gateways, configuration fields only

list_router_adverts.description: List radvd router advertisement entries, one per interface

list_shaper_pipes.description: List traffic shaper pipes with optional enabled/description filters

enabled.description: When set, filter to enabled or disabled pipes only

fetch_all.description: When true, paginate until all rows are returned

list_shaper_queues.description: List traffic shaper queues with optional enabled/description filters

enabled.description: When set, filter to enabled or disabled queues only

fetch_all.description: When true, paginate until all rows are returned

list_shaper_rules.description: List traffic shaper rules with optional filters

enabled.description: When set, filter to enabled or disabled rules only

fetch_all.description: When true, paginate until all rows are returned

list_snapshots.description: List ZFS boot environment snapshots, where the platform supports them

mk_alias.description: Create a firewall alias; returns the existing one if the name is taken

content.description: Members: addresses, networks, ports or codes

type.description: Alias type, one of: host, network, port, url, urltable, geoip, networkgroup, mac, asn, dynipv6host, authgroup, internal, external

mk_dhcp_host.description: Create a DHCP host reservation in the dnsmasq host table (Services → DHCPv4 → Hosts). Requires hostname and MAC; at least one of ipv4 or ipv6 suffix must be provided. Optional client_id (DUID) improves stateful DHCPv6 matching when MAC alone is insufficient — copy from the dhcp tool v6 lease client_id. Defaults to a dry run; pass apply=true to write and reconfigure dnsmasq.

apply.description: Apply the change. Omit/false = dry run.

client_id.description: Optional DHCP client identifier / DUID for IPv6 (e.g. '52:54:00:7e:9c:f4:00:ab:cd:01'). Accepts optional 'id:' prefix.

mk_gateway.description: Create a gateway on an interface

far_gateway.description: Next hop outside the interface subnet

monitor_disable.description: Turn off monitoring, usual for a point-to-point transit

mk_nat_outbound.description: Create an outbound source NAT rule for a source network or alias

source_net.description: Source network or alias name to translate

target.description: Translation address; empty means the interface address

mk_npt_rule.description: Create an NPTv6 rule translating an internal IPv6 prefix to an external one

destination_net.description: External prefix; omit when using trackif

interface.description: Interface the translation applies on, usually wan

trackif.description: Interface whose delegated prefix supplies the external side

mk_route.description: Create a static route via a configured gateway

mk_snapshot.description: Create a ZFS boot environment snapshot, where the platform supports it

mk_vip.description: Create an interface virtual IP, an IP alias by default

mode.description: One of: ipalias, carp, proxyarp, other (default ipalias)

vhid.description: CARP virtual host id; required only for mode=carp

mk_vlan.description: Create an 802.1Q VLAN device on a parent interface

mkdns.description: Add a DNS host override in Unbound

enabled.description: Whether the override is active (default: true)

server.description: IP address this hostname resolves to

move_dhcp_host.description: Move or rename a DHCP host reservation (dnsmasq). IPv4 is the reliable contract; IPv6 (::N suffix) applies only to stateful-DHCPv6 clients. Defaults to a dry run; pass apply=true to write. The client keeps its old address until it renews or reboots.

apply.description: Apply the change. Omit/false = dry run.

client_id.description: Set or replace DHCP client identifier / DUID for IPv6 (e.g. '52:54:00:7e:9c:f4:00:ab:cd:01'). Accepts optional 'id:' prefix.

host.description: Hostname or MAC of the reservation to move

ipv4.description: New IPv4: last octet (e.g. 2) or full address

new_hostname.description: New dnsmasq host reservation name (optional rename)

nat_outbound_mode.description: Read or set outbound source NAT generation mode

mode.description: When setting: one of automatic, hybrid

packet_capture.description: Start, stop, or fetch a packet capture file

raw.description: Return raw PCAP file if true (default: false)

stream.description: If true, stream pcap data to chat (hex preview)

pf_states.description: List active PF state table entries with filters and summary

pf_statistics.description: Show PF statistics and state table pressure

plan_dns_ula.description: Read-only: map AAAA host overrides from a delegated prefix onto a ULA prefix

public_names.description: Fully qualified names the outside world resolves; these keep their delegated address

ula_prefix.description: Target ULA prefix of the same length

restore_shaper_snapshot.description: Restore traffic shaper config from a prior snapshot_id. Set remove_orphans=true to delete pipes/queues/rules not in the snapshot.

remove_orphans.description: Delete live objects whose UUID is absent from the snapshot

rm_alias.description: Delete a firewall alias; requires a confirm token from a prior call

confirm.description: Token returned by the first call

rm_dhcp_host.description: Delete a DHCP host reservation from the dnsmasq host table (Services → DHCPv4 → Hosts). Accepts hostname, MAC, or reservation uuid. Defaults to a dry run; pass apply=true to delete and reconfigure dnsmasq.

apply.description: Apply the deletion. Omit/false = dry run.

host.description: Hostname, MAC, or reservation uuid to delete

rm_nat_outbound.description: Delete an outbound source NAT rule; requires a confirm token

rm_npt_rule.description: Delete an NPTv6 rule; requires a confirm token from a prior call

rm_route.description: Delete a static route; requires a confirm token from a prior call

rm_vip.description: Delete an interface virtual IP; requires a confirm token

rm_vlan.description: Delete a VLAN device; refuses while it is assigned to an interface

rmdns.description: Delete a DNS host override from Unbound

uuid.description: UUID of the host override to delete (from dns tool output)

rule_uuid.description: UUID of the rule to delete

set_alias.description: Update a firewall alias; unspecified fields keep their values

content.description: Replacement members; omit to keep the current set

set_dhcp_subnet_dns.description: Update DHCP-provided DNS servers for one address family on a subnet scope (dnsmasq or Kea backends). Single address updates slot 1 unless slot=2.

dns_servers.description: One or two DNS server addresses

family.description: Address family to update: ipv4 or ipv6

interface.description: Interface identifier or description (e.g. opt2, VLAN2wired)

slot.description: Optional slot index (1 or 2) for single-address updates

set_fw_rule.description: Edit fields of an existing firewall rule

log.description: Log packets matched by this rule

quick.description: Stop evaluating further rules on a match

rule_uuid.description: UUID of the rule to edit (from fw_rules output)

set_host_override.description: Edit an existing Unbound host override in place; use mkdns to create one

uuid.description: Override uuid, from the dns tool

set_router_advert.description: Update a radvd entry: enable it, change mode, or deprecate the old prefix

mode.description: radvd mode, for example managed or unmanaged

preferred_lifetime.description: Advertised preferred lifetime; 0 deprecates the prefix

set_shaper_pipe.description: Update a traffic shaper pipe by uuid (apply=true by default)

shaper_statistics.description: Get traffic shaper runtime statistics with structured hints; optional baseline_id compares against a prior snapshot

baseline_id.description: Optional baseline id from a prior shaper_statistics call for pkts/bytes delta comparison

ssh_fw_rule.description: Create firewall rules via SSH (bypasses API issues)

toggle_alias.description: Enable or disable a firewall alias

enabled.description: Target state; this is not a blind flip

toggle_dhcp_range.description: Enable or disable a dnsmasq DHCP range on OPNsense. Identify the range by interface (e.g. opt10), subnet CIDR (e.g. 172.20.5.0/24), or range uuid. Defaults to dry run; pass apply=true to write and reconfigure dnsmasq.

enabled.description: True to enable the range, False to disable DHCP on it

toggle_fw_rule.description: Enable or disable a firewall rule

enabled.description: True to enable the rule, False to disable it

rule_uuid.description: UUID of the rule to toggle (from fw_rules output)

toggle_nat_outbound.description: Enable or disable an outbound source NAT rule

toggle_npt_rule.description: Enable or disable an NPTv6 rule

toggle_route.description: Enable or disable a static route

toggle_shaper_pipe.description: Toggle a traffic shaper pipe enabled state
